findings.highlight: the castle is built within a hidden mountain
findings.evidenceJa: 人知れぬ山間の城
findings.governingReading: a castle hidden among remote mountains
findings.explanation: The castle is relocated inside a mountain rather than among unknown mountain valleys.

findings.highlight: they have been obsessed
findings.evidenceJa: とうに正気を失っていた
findings.governingReading: they had long since lost their sanity
findings.explanation: Literal loss of sanity is weakened to obsession.

findings.highlight: Their family, with their perfected Magic Circuits
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路として完成された一族の作品
findings.governingReading: a creation of the clan perfected as a Magic Circuit
findings.explanation: The planned homunculus “work” is replaced by the biological family collectively possessing good circuits.

findings.highlight: if she was going to murmur something, she would get stronger when she would insult and hate someone
findings.evidenceJa: 嘆くのならば、その原因である誰かを嫌った方が強くなれる
findings.governingReading: rather than lament, she could stay stronger by hating whoever caused her pain
findings.explanation: Illya’s survival logic becomes repetitive, malformed speculation about murmuring.

findings.highlight: The pain had lessened
findings.evidenceJa: 少女を襲う苦痛も消えていた
findings.governingReading: the pain assaulting the girl had disappeared
findings.explanation: The completed end of Illya’s summoning pain becomes partial improvement.

findings.highlight: did not need any friends or collaborators
findings.evidenceJa: 頼りになる協力者も親愛なる友人もいらない
findings.governingReading: needed neither dependable allies nor beloved friends
findings.explanation: The specific forms of trust and affection Illya denies herself disappear.

findings.highlight: A bluff to ignore the fact that she was fated to have nothing
findings.evidenceJa: どうしても与えられぬ自身を誤魔化す為の、精一杯の虚勢
findings.governingReading: desperate bravado meant to deceive herself about the things she could never be given
findings.explanation: The defense against deprivation becomes a vague fate to possess nothing.

findings.highlight: the arm covered in blood
findings.evidenceJa: 返り血で真紅に染まった腕
findings.governingReading: the arm dyed crimson with spattered blood
findings.explanation: The vivid color and source of the blood disappear.

findings.highlight: her body was destroyed
findings.evidenceJa: 自身の腕が破裂する
findings.governingReading: her own arm burst apart
findings.explanation: The localized recurring injury to Illya’s arm becomes total bodily destruction.

findings.highlight: she endured it for his sake
findings.evidenceJa: 彼を死なせない為に
findings.governingReading: she endured her body’s collapse to keep him from dying
findings.explanation: Illya’s exact protective purpose is generalized.

findings.highlight: her lung must have been pierced
findings.evidenceJa: 肺を破かれた
findings.governingReading: perhaps her lung had been torn open
findings.explanation: The bodily mechanism changes from tearing to piercing.

findings.highlight: How much power was left in him?
findings.evidenceJa: どこにそれだけの力が残っていたのか
findings.governingReading: where could that much strength possibly have remained
findings.explanation: Astonishment at the impossible source of strength becomes a request for quantity.

findings.highlight: the regulation of the world that hates inconsistencies
findings.evidenceJa: 矛盾を嫌う世界からの粛正
findings.governingReading: the purge imposed by a world that abhors contradictions
findings.explanation: The world’s violent corrective force becomes administrative regulation.

findings.highlight: the body that is crumbling away like sand
findings.evidenceJa: 砂と化して崩れていく岩の体
findings.governingReading: the rock body crumbling as it turns into sand
findings.explanation: A literal material dissolution becomes a visual simile.

findings.highlight: has to be invincible
findings.evidenceJa: 不撓不屈でなければならぬ
findings.governingReading: must remain unbowed and indomitable
findings.explanation: Berserker’s final moral endurance is changed into continued combat invincibility.

findings.highlight: The hand that was grasping through empty space finally touches something
findings.evidenceJa: 指先が、たしかな感触に包まれる
findings.governingReading: her fingertips are enveloped in a certain, solid sensation
findings.explanation: Illya’s delicate tactile arrival becomes a generic hand contact.

findings.highlight: the girl crawls to the hard figure
findings.evidenceJa: 硬い体にすがりついた
findings.governingReading: the girl clings to the hard body
findings.explanation: The culminating embrace is reduced to approach.

findings.highlight: She cannot see anymore
findings.evidenceJa: 自分にはもう確かめられない
findings.governingReading: she can no longer confirm it for herself
findings.explanation: Illya’s epistemic dependence on touch becomes another statement of blindness.

findings.highlight: she wanted for him to pick her up once
findings.evidenceJa: 一度ぐらい抱きあげてほしかった
findings.governingReading: she had wanted him to pick her up just once
findings.explanation: An unnecessary preposition breaks Illya’s final childlike wish.

findings.highlight: It feels as though he’ll rest one of his big, solid hands on her head
findings.evidenceJa: てのひらが乗せられるような気がした
findings.governingReading: she felt as though a huge, hard palm had been placed on her head
findings.explanation: A present imagined sensation becomes a future action.

findings.highlight: peacefully falls asleep
findings.evidenceJa: 幸せに意識を閉じた
findings.governingReading: happily lets her consciousness close
findings.explanation: Illya’s happiness at Berserker’s protection becomes generic peaceful sleep.

findings.highlight: the girl that went to sleep
findings.evidenceJa: 安らかに眠りについた、白い少女
findings.governingReading: the white girl who had peacefully fallen asleep
findings.explanation: The calm, color, and vulnerability of Illya’s final image disappear.

findings.highlight: Fear of being killed mixes with my desire to kill him
findings.evidenceJa: 正気が消えた
findings.governingReading: fear of being killed and hatred urging murder mixed until sanity vanished
findings.explanation: The endpoint of Shirou’s conflicting fear and hatred—loss of sanity—is absent.
